EXCLAMATION_MARK.rationale: Landing-hero block is the documented exception to the no-exclamation-mark rule (CAP-6 voice-and-tone microcopy). The hero is a marketing surface; everywhere else exclamation marks are banned.

PUSH_NOTIFICATION.rationale: Toast dismiss button aria-label is screen-reader copy for the in-page toast widget, not a push notification channel. Campus-only product has no push channel.

TIER_WITHOUT_CODE.rationale: Test fixture pages (public/*-test.html) and the tier-table JS modules use tier names without codes inside test data tables and assertion descriptions. These are not shipped to users and exist only for the per-slice verify scripts to assert tier-specific behavior.
